Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 685% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 71 cases per week this week.
Mpox cases in the US are rising with a 72% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 48 cases per week this week.
Polio Wikipedia readership is rising to the 84th percentile of the past year, indicating increased public interest.
Influenza hospital admissions in the US are rising with a 58% increase over the past month, reaching 9,619 cases this week.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising with a 1275% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 106 cases per week this week.
Hepatitis A cases in the US are at baseline with a 14% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 16 cases per week this week.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising with a 66% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 271 cases per week this week.
Group A strep is rising in public attention, with Wikipedia readership at the 54th percentile of the past year.
Malaria cases in the US are rising, with a 52% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months and 1,147 cases this year compared to 1,424 last year.
RSV hospital admissions in the US are rising, with 1,233 cases this week up 42% from the previous month.
Whooping cough cases in the US are rising, with 12,328 cases this year compared to 29,806 last year.
COVID-19 hospital admissions in the US are at baseline with 4,519 cases this week, up 5% from the previous month.
Typhoid fever has baseline activity with Wikipedia readership at the 42nd percentile of the past year.
